_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/triggers/test_delayed_trigger_this_combat.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. t_dtc_love is Love on the Battlefield on a {W} enchantment: an attack with exactly two creatures gives them first strike, draws a card, and installs a this_combat delayed trigger scoped to them that puts a +1/+1 counter on whichever connects. The vigilant 2/2s, the double striker and the bears come from testing.cards.json.

cards.name: Test Battlefield Romance
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you attack with exactly two creatures, those creatures gain first strike until end of turn, then draw a card. Whenever either of those creatures deals combat damage to a player this combat, put a +1/+1 counter on it.

abilities.text: Whenever you attack with exactly two creatures, those creatures gain first strike until end of turn, then draw a card. Whenever either of those creatures deals combat damage to a player this combat, put a +1/+1 counter on it.

effects.text: Whenever either of those creatures deals combat damage to a player this combat, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
